questions.stem: Consider this: A guest shoved at a party sues for battery after unwanted contact. The contact was accidental. Which statement best states the governing legal rule on these facts?

A contact is battery only if it causes a physical injury on these facts.
An accidental bump is battery if the defendant should have been more careful on these facts.
